meta.rates_unit: decimal per year (0.05 = 5 %); every currency: last observation dated strictly before the print date; USD: one EXTRA business day (see usd_rate_asymmetry)
meta.carry_convention: (i_fx - i_usd) * days / 360 with i_usd = effective fed funds of the last calendar day before the print (accrual, NOT the USD column of aux['rates']); days = calendar days since the previous print; first row NaN
meta.cpi_convention: index level; a monthly observation is usable from the 1st day of the 2nd month after its reference month starts, a quarterly one (AUD, NZD) from the 1st day of the 4th month after its reference quarter starts; step function until the next release; current-vintage data (NOT real-time vintages)
meta.oil_convention: WTI spot price level (USD/bbl), FRED DCOILWTICO, last observation dated strictly before the print; non-positive observations (one: -36.98 on 2020-04-20) are set to NaN before the <= 3-print forward-fill, so every value in aux['oil'] is > 0
meta.universe_mask_note: True where the price AND the carry of the instrument are known at the row (an instrument without a financing leg may not be held: the engine refuses it)
meta.usd_rate_asymmetry: aux['rates']['USD'] = effective fed funds of the Federal Reserve business day two before the print date (already published at 14:15 Europe/Berlin). carry and tbill are NOT built from it: they accrue the rate of the last calendar day before the print. Hence carry[c] = aux['rates'][c] * days/360 - tbill, and carry[c] != (rates[c] - rates['USD']) * days/360.
meta.print_convention: Row = one ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate. The rate is fixed in the daily concertation around 14:10 CET and PUBLISHED around 16:00 CET the same day (conductor note 2026-11-10, from the data-sources researcher; not re-verified by this build). The row timestamp is the fixing date at 14:15 Europe/Berlin converted to UTC — the conservative DECISION instant (the information content of the price is no later than 14:15). Price = USD per 1 unit of foreign currency, crossed through the euro: EUR = USD per EUR; X = (USD per EUR) / (X per EUR). Primary evaluation is lag = 1 (fill at the next fixing). The reference rate is a published mid, not a dealable quote.

excluded_from_universe_groups.SGD: no defensible rate series (MAS targets the exchange rate; BIS has no SG policy rate) -> price column is loaded, carry is NaN, not in G10/EM

meta.usd_leg_publication_note: The effective federal funds rate of day t-1 (FRED DFF) is released by the New York Fed on day t at about 09:00 New York time (its stated schedule; not re-verified by this build) = 15:00 Berlin time, i.e. about 45 minutes AFTER the 14:15 row timestamp (14:00 Berlin time during the US/EU daylight-saving mismatch weeks). The carry accrual for (t-1, t] correctly uses the t-1 rate. For SIGNALS the USD column of aux['rates'] is therefore lagged one extra business day (conductor ruling 2026-11-10) - see usd_rate_asymmetry.

EUR.series: ECB EON/D.EONIA_TO.RATE (EONIA) through 2019-09-30, then ECB EST/B.EU000A2X2A25.WT (euro short-term rate)

GBP.series: FRED IUDSOIA (SONIA) from 1997-01-02; BIS WS_CBPOL D.GB before
GBP.bis_compilation: From 3 Aug 2006 onwards: official bank rate; from 6 May 1997 to 2 Aug 2006: repo rate; from 20 Aug 1981 to 5 May 1997: minimum Bank of England Band 1 dealing rate; from 16 Oct 1972 to 19 Aug 1981: minimum lending rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 15 Oct 1972: bank rate.

JPY.series: BIS WS_CBPOL D.JP (daily central bank policy rate); inside the BIS 'no policy rate' windows: FRED IRSTCI01JPM156N (OECD immediate rate, call money/interbank, monthly average), month M used from the 1st day of month M+1
JPY.bis_compilation: From 24 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.25 percent; From 17 Jun 2026 to 23 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent; From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.75 percent; From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.50 percent; From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25% ; From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %; from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%. Short-term policy interest rate; from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate; from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%; from 19 Dec 2008 to 4 Oct 2010: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0. %; from 31 Oct 2008 to 18 Dec 2008: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.3%; before 30 Oct 2008, refer to https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL

gap_fill.deviation_from_brief: the brief asks for BIS daily policy rates; BIS has none for JPY in these windows

CHF.bis_compilation: From 13 June 2019 onwards SNB Policy rate; From 1 Jan 2000 to 12 June 2019 mid-point of the SNB target range; from 1 Jan 1946 to 31 Dec 1999: discount rate.

CAD.series: BIS WS_CBPOL D.CA (daily central bank policy rate)

AUD.bis_compilation: From 2 Aug 1990 onwards: cash rate target; from 23 Jan 1990 to 1 Aug 1990: middle of the cash rate target range; from 7 Apr 1976 to 22 Jan 1990: interbank overnight cash rate.

NOK.series: BIS WS_CBPOL D.NO (daily central bank policy rate)

MXN.series: BIS WS_CBPOL D.MX (daily central bank policy rate)

USD.series: FRED DFF (effective federal funds rate, 7-day series)

signal_column.rule: DFF of the Federal Reserve business day before L, L = last such day strictly before the print date
signal_column.business_day_calendar: dates with a rate in the Federal Reserve H.10 release (FRED DEX* series); weekdays after the last H.10 date (2026-11-06)

USD.asymmetry: aux['rates']['USD'] is lagged one extra business day (published before the print); carry and tbill use the one-day-lagged accrual rate described in 'asof'

oil_series.series: FRED DCOILWTICO (WTI spot, USD per barrel), price LEVEL, lagged one day

price_gaps.rule: forward-fill at most 3 consecutive missing prints inside an instrument's life; longer gaps stay NaN
